title: import-mapping
$comment: APPROVED D-043 (c): the mapping a person confirms (saveImportMapping, T-017) holds only source_column, target_field and transform; the AI's suggestion keeps ai-mapping.schema.json (confidence, evidence, requires_confirmation). Both use the target fields and transforms defined here. The target fields are canonical-event.schema.json's members (with D-059's end_timestamp, shift and product, APPROVED H-018). D-070 (PROPOSED, T-017): the four transforms of D-009 only (no constant, unit or expression transform; CB-28), each allowed for the target fields named in allOf below; a column whose target_field is null is not imported. Which target a column may take, that every source column is a column of the import, that no source column and no target other than metadata repeats, that case_id, event_type and timestamp are mapped and that at most 64 columns go to metadata are the server's checks (D-070).

ColumnMapping.description: One source column (a profile column name: the CSV header or a JSON events member name, D-043) and the canonical-event field it fills, through transform. target_field null: the column is not imported (for example an operator ID, ELECTRONICS_LINE §6).

TargetField.description: A canonical-event.schema.json member a column can fill. metadata takes any number of columns (at most 64), each under its source column's name; every other field takes at most one.

Transform.description: D-009 / D-070: how a source value becomes the field's value; never an expression, script or code. identity: the text as it is (a JSON events value: a string, or a number's literal as written; any JSON value for metadata). rfc3339: an RFC 3339 date-time with an offset (Z or ±hh:mm), kept as written; no time zone is ever assumed. integer_ms: a whole number of milliseconds written in JSON's integer grammar without a sign (0 to 9007199254740991). boolean_literal: true or false (ASCII letters in any case, or a JSON boolean). An empty value (an empty CSV field, a JSON null, an empty string or a missing member) leaves the field out.
